name: Gaussian Transformation to World Space
definition: Transforms Gaussian parameters predicted in camera space into world space for rendering, using a 4x4 camera-to-world extrinsics matrix T containing rotation R and translation t.
summary: This method converts 3D Gaussian parameters from camera to world space, distinguishing itself by transforming full anisotropic covariances and spherical harmonics rather than just ray coordinates or point positions.
